name: Ryzen 7 9800X3D
note: The card most gaming builds are paired with, and modest for its reputation: 162 W at the socket is less than half what a Core i9 of the same era asks for.

name: Ryzen 7 7800X3D
note: Identical power limits to the 9800X3D that replaced it, which is why a supply bought for one fits the other.

name: Core Ultra 9 285K
note: Rated to 250 W, with a 295 W extreme profile some boards enable by default. If yours does, size against that instead.

name: Core i9-14900K
note: The clearest case for ignoring TDP: a 125 W label on a part that draws 253 W whenever it boosts.
